title: Account Overview
description: Money in the account, what was staked, what came back, and what it cost.

target.queryText:
SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Account value

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT total FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT total FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description:
Cash plus holdings at market, as the broker reported it at the last evening reading.

A reading taken from the broker, not a starting balance with P&L added on.

panels.title: Free to deploy

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT available FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT available FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description:
Credit balance minus the margin blocked against open positions.

- **Margin** — cash the broker holds against an open position. Still yours, but not spendable until the position closes.

panels.title: Holdings at market

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT holdings_value FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT holdings_value FROM v_account_value ORDER BY session_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description:
Demat holdings valued at the last traded price at the time of the reading.

- **Demat holdings** — shares actually held in the account, as opposed to intraday positions closed the same day.
- **Marked to market** — valued at the current price rather than at what you paid.

panels.title: Total bet amount

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bet_amount), 0) AS value FROM v_bet
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bet_amount), 0) AS value FROM v_bet

panels.description:
Quantity × price summed over every recorded fill, buys and sells alike.

- **Bet amount** — the rupee value that changed hands on a fill. Turnover, not money at risk: buying and later selling the same share counts twice.

panels.title: Net gain / loss

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_pnl), 0) AS value FROM v_daily_pnl
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_pnl), 0) AS value FROM v_daily_pnl

panels.description:
Realised profit after costs, summed over every session.

- **Gross P&L** — profit from price movement alone.
- **Net P&L** — gross minus brokerage, taxes and fees. This is what actually reached the account.

Closed lots only. Open positions are not counted.

panels.title: Taxes and charges

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charges), 0) AS value FROM v_daily_pnl
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charges), 0) AS value FROM v_daily_pnl

panels.description:
What trading cost, summed over every session.

- **Brokerage** — the broker's own fee.
- **Taxes** — STT, stamp duty and GST.
- **Fees** — exchange and SEBI charges.

panels.title: Account value over time

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', session_date) AS INTEGER) AS time,
       account_value           AS "Account value",
       broker_cash             AS "Cash",
       broker_holdings         AS "Holdings",
       realized_net_cumulative AS "Cumulative net P&L"
FROM v_account_equity
ORDER BY session_date
targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', session_date) AS INTEGER) AS time,
       account_value           AS "Account value",
       broker_cash             AS "Cash",
       broker_holdings         AS "Holdings",
       realized_net_cumulative AS "Cumulative net P&L"
FROM v_account_equity
ORDER BY session_date

panels.description:
Two different claims, plotted together on purpose.

- **Account value** — what the broker reported that evening: cash plus holdings at market.
- **Cumulative net P&L** — derived from closed lots. Ignores deposits, withdrawals, and anything traded outside this journal.

Before the first broker reading, the value line falls back to the derived one.

**Notes** (cyan dashed lines) — notes tagged `BUY` or `SELL` on any symbol's chart. Hover a marker to read the note and see which symbol it was for.

**Noted calls** (light-blue buys, orange sells; dashed lines) — calls you documented with `trades note`, for every symbol. Hover a marker for the symbol, the sentiment and your note.

panels.title: Gains and losses per day

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', session_date) AS INTEGER) AS time,
       gross_pnl AS "Gross P&L",
       net_pnl   AS "Net P&L"
FROM v_daily_pnl
ORDER BY session_date
targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', session_date) AS INTEGER) AS time,
       gross_pnl AS "Gross P&L",
       net_pnl   AS "Net P&L"
FROM v_daily_pnl
ORDER BY session_date

panels.description:
Realised profit per session.

- **Gross P&L** — profit from price movement alone.
- **Net P&L** — gross minus all charges.

The gap between the two bars is the cost of trading.

panels.title: Bet amount per day

targets.rawQueryText:

       bet_amount AS "Bet amount",
       trades     AS "Trades"
FROM v_daily_pnl
ORDER BY session_date
targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', session_date) AS INTEGER) AS time,
       bet_amount AS "Bet amount",
       trades     AS "Trades"
FROM v_daily_pnl
ORDER BY session_date

panels.description:
How much was put to work each session, and across how many fills.

- **Bet amount** — quantity × price summed over the day's fills. Turnover, not money at risk.
- **Trades** — number of fills that session.

panels.description:
Stacked on purpose: what matters is the total drag on a small move, not which line is which.

- **Brokerage** — the broker's own fee.
- **Taxes** — STT, stamp duty and GST.
- **Fees** — exchange and SEBI charges.

panels.title: Every fill, biggest bet first

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Date",
       symbol       AS "Symbol",
       side         AS "Side",
       product      AS "Product",
       quantity     AS "Qty",
       price        AS "Price",
       bet_amount   AS "Bet amount",
       charges      AS "Charges"
FROM v_bet
ORDER BY bet_amount DESC
LIMIT 500
targets.queryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Date",
       symbol       AS "Symbol",
       side         AS "Side",
       product      AS "Product",
       quantity     AS "Qty",
       price        AS "Price",
       bet_amount   AS "Bet amount",
       charges      AS "Charges"
FROM v_bet
ORDER BY bet_amount DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.description:
Every recorded fill, largest first. Capped at 500 rows.

- **Bet amount** — quantity × price, the rupee value that changed hands.
- **Product** — MIS is intraday, squared off the same day. CNC is delivery.

panels.title: What the account holds
panels.description:
The positions behind the account value, as of the last balance reading.

A blank **Last price** means no quote came back, and the position is counted at cost.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol                AS "Symbol",
       quantity                AS "Qty",
       average_price           AS "Avg cost",
       last_price              AS "Last",
       market_value            AS "Value",
       unrealised              AS "Unrealised",
       unrealised_pct          AS "Unrealised %"
FROM v_current_holdings
ORDER BY market_value DESC

panels.description: The newest of: the last fill imported, the last account balance recorded, and the last time the reasons for trades were worked out. The daemon pulls fills every few minutes while the market is open and the evening batch reads the balance, so this is how old the figures on this page can be.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT MAX(t) * 1000 AS "Last data refresh" FROM (
  SELECT MAX(imported_at) AS t FROM trade
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM account_balance
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(recorded_at) FROM trade_reason)
